journeys.measurement: Measure visible selection and saved-draft return feedback after keyboard activation in normal and reduced-motion contexts.

composition.observation: The creation entry uses a centered introduction above a spacious two-column card grid on desktop; mobile places the prominent manual card first in a single readable column. The editor then preserves a recognizably denser authoring workspace rather than inserting another setup screen.

hierarchy.observation: The large Create a Chronicle heading, short invitation and warm-edged manual card establish the available next action. The other choices remain visibly secondary with Coming soon labels. The untitled heading, Chronicle Details action and saved named Library card give the subsequent steps distinct landmarks.

typography.observation: The cream serif display heading and stronger sans-serif card titles separate invitation from action. Body copy and field labels remain legible at the captured mobile width. The description textareas use a monospaced face while neighboring inputs use the interface face; this is the optional visual refinement recorded below, not an obstacle to authoring.

spacing.observation: The introduction has clear separation from the card actions and each card has generous internal padding. At mobile width the cards retain useful side gutters. Details fields are separated vertically and Save details is separated from Content warnings, including at the bottom of the mobile saved state.

controls.observation: Manual creation is a broad card-sized action and requires no metadata before opening the editor. Rename changes to an ordinary text input with Apply title and Cancel controls; Details exposes labeled native inputs, selects and textareas plus a distinct Save details button. The recordings show these controls operating without a replacement editor route. The refreshed same-source full-page images expose the complete metadata form in both themes, including cover asset selection and the saved footer.

contrast.observation: The primary dark captures have strong cream text against deep teal, readable muted explanatory copy and distinguishable gold actions. Disabled choices remain readable rather than being faded away; cyan keyboard outlines stand out from their surroundings. Refreshed same-source light-theme desktop/mobile full-page captures show dark teal text and readable gold/brown labels against warm pale surfaces, with clear field boundaries and saved feedback.

consistency.observation: The entry, editor and return Library preserve the same Voyagewright identity, teal/gold palette, global navigation and account affordance. Card corners, fine borders and line icons are coherent with the supplied public-entry references. Those references establish the shell family, not a pixel template for an authoring form.

states.observation: The captured sequence distinguishes available choices, an owned Untitled Chronicle draft, unsaved changes during editing, a Saved at acknowledgement and a named private draft in the Library. A new empty draft begins with Chapter One and an empty Passage drop area. Conflict and failed-save recovery are supported by the separate focused browser evidence, not shown in the primary recording.

responsive.observation: At the captured 390-pixel mobile viewport the creation card text wraps within its card and the authoring toolbar wraps into usable rows. Details becomes a single column; the close action, fields and saved footer remain within the viewport width. The section strip scrolls horizontally instead of forcing the whole page wider. Refreshed same-source full-page light/dark mobile captures also show all four choice cards and the complete Details form without clipped labels or page-width overflow. Mobile captures remain emulation evidence only.

keyboard.observation: All four traces show Tab traversal and Enter activation for the natural Create Chronicle entry, manual card, rename, Apply title, Details, Save details, Close Details and Studio return. The recordings show the corresponding visible state changes. Traversal from Save details back to the top Close control cycles through the nonmodal editor; Shift+Tab or Escape provides a shorter route. Separate focused tests assert title Enter/Escape behavior; Details Escape was checked in the event handler after the rendered review rather than replayed in these traces.

focus.observation: The creation and editor heading outlines provide a visible route landmark; the manual card and subsequent toolbar controls have clear focus outlines in the recordings. The final mobile reduced recording visibly focuses the Studio return link. Supporting browser assertions verify focus on Details heading when opened and on its trigger when closed; the reviewed close handler restores that same trigger after Escape.

feedback.observation: Manual activation shows Opening your Chronicle before the editor appears. Editing exposes Unsaved changes and the Save details action produces a readable Saved at timestamp, both in the toolbar and beside the form action. Returning to the Library visibly displays the renamed draft and description, confirming that the save feedback corresponds to a persistent user outcome.

motion.observation: Normal recordings show brief fades between Library, choices and editor, with no prolonged animated prerequisite to manual creation. Reduced-motion recordings reach the same actions and saved return states without the visible route fade. Actual recordings were sampled at half-second intervals and representative frames were inspected at native size; this supports transition continuity and gross waiting judgments, not a frame-time or physical-device smoothness claim.

continuity.observation: The journey starts in the authenticated Creator Library, visits creation choices, returns without creating a draft, re-enters choices, creates and edits a draft, then returns to that same Library and to the creation entry again. The account shell persists and the Library count increases only after manual creation. The saved draft keeps its entered title and description.

complexity.observation: The entry offers four understandable methods with one currently available action and no mandatory title/metadata wizard. Metadata stays in a named, closable region of the existing editor. The editor contains many established tools, especially in the mobile Passage list, but the new title and Details actions remain in the first toolbar group and do not require navigating that list.

role-outcomes.observation: The synthetic Creator visibly creates a real owned untitled draft, renames it, saves description data in the canonical editor, and finds the named private draft back in the authenticated Library on desktop and mobile in both motion modes. The supporting production journeys exercise wider metadata persistence, reopen behavior and governed publishing consumers. No owner acceptance or physical-device outcome is inferred.

fallbacks.observation: Manual creation stands alone without AI, an imported document or a whole-Chronicle template. The AI card visibly says Coming soon in the primary evidence, and the desktop reduced recording exposes the same unavailable labels on Adapt a Story and Start from a Template. Refreshed same-source full-page mobile images show all three Coming soon labels with readable text and no apparent alternate action. Supporting tests verify all three disabled choices do not create drafts, ordinary sign-in is required and interrupted preparation/save can recover without discarding local edits.

findings.observation: The short/long description and content-warning textareas use a monospaced face while title, address and adjacent form controls use the interface face. A matching proportional input face could give the narrative metadata form a more uniform visual texture. The current text remains legible and operable; no contract failure or accepted-reference violation is claimed.

inspection.renderedMethod: Viewed original key screenshots, all 32 screenshots in labeled contact sheets, and actual frames extracted from all four recordings at 2 fps with representative native-size frames; inspected all four trace action summaries. Derived sheets are reviewer scratch only.
inspection.supportingVerification: The original 29 focused component/authorization tests passed on source 66bc6df56a95aaba09bb6b3dfb2e4cddfdc85f62. Refreshed frozen-source production run on 3aaaf45e9e28b346476885b9f6eaa858bbaf6de0 passed all eight Chromium journeys and cleanup, including desktop/mobile metadata persistence, conflict recovery and failed-save retry. Original consumer run had three passes, one Brightwork selector failure and a Phase 5 skip; corrected Brightwork, dedicated Homeport N and actual isolated production Phase 5 immutable publication logs subsequently pass. These remain focused evidence rather than protected mainline acceptance.

limitations: Primary trusted packet covers synthetic Creator at desktop and emulated mobile widths in normal and reduced motion. No physical-device, assistive-technology or owner PRODUCT_ACCEPTED claim is made.

The unchanged trusted packet is dark theme. The eight refreshed full-page supporting images provide inspected light/dark desktop/mobile coverage for the same frozen candidate and source digest, including the lower mobile choice cards and complete Details form. They remain separate supporting evidence rather than additional trusted packet artifacts.
The primary traces use Tab and Enter, not Escape. Title Escape and focus restoration have supporting passing browser assertions; Details Escape has the narrow source-handler check described above.
